evidence: User reports listening to every clip, no birds or other anomalies; some room reflections and one or two angry barks.
interpretation: Reflections and barking styles accepted as variation. Generic captions retained; no per-clip acoustic labels inferred.
split_policy: Keep official folds: 1-3 train, 4 validation, 5 test. Test clips excluded from encoder caching, optimization and checkpoint selection.
limitation: User reports listening to all clips, including potentially test clips; test partition is held out from training, not an unseen listening set.
